**Finding submitted — deviation (fallback target).**

- **Responsive clause:** § 1.4 (p0008–p0009) is the only grant in our favour — access to and the right to use HDI's hosting system, software and Content administration tools. The § 6.1 trademark licence runs the other way (Company → HDI), so it is out of scope for this rule.
- **Failure:** the grant runs to "the Company" alone, and § 10.3 states that "no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement" — our affiliates are excluded with no path to add them, so the fallback affiliate element fails.
- **Already met:** § 10.3 makes the Agreement enforceable by the parties' "successors and assigns" with no consent gate, satisfying the successor-transfer element; no new wording added there.
- **Not flagged:** HDI has no at-will revocation right (so not walk-away), and the 90-day termination in § 4.1 is a renewal/termination issue, not a licence revocation — not double-flagged here.
- **Cure:** one appended sentence in § 1.4 permitting the Company, on written notice to HDI, to let its affiliates exercise the Company's access and use rights — phrased as an exercise of our own rights so it does not conflict with the retained § 10.3 third-party bar.
